description: JSON output schema for `bb auth status --json`. Data contains the currently configured Bitbucket connection and auth settings.

auth_source.description: Source of the auth configuration (env, keyring, config).

bitbucket_url.description: The configured Bitbucket Data Center base URL.

bb_version.description: Version of the bb binary that produced this document. Provenance for stored output, not a compatibility switch: pin the binary to pin the contract (ADR-064).

limit_reached.description: Present on listing commands: true when the result set came back at --limit and there may be more behind it.

title: bb auth status output
